fusions.name: Rim Bash
fusions.desc: Smashes the target for 15 damage and throws it back 3 tiles, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipped Disc
fusions.desc: Skips the shield for 5 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Bastion
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 30 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Braced
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks a share of your maximum health. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
